title: Grow your first delivery
summary: One animated introduction and one card-driven teaching season replace public edition navigation and dashboard-first play. Compare real calculated plans, respond to maintenance, and record a simulated delivery.

changes.title: One consistent beginner journey
changes.description: Swipe decision cards and use the action area below them. A noninteractive 2.5D farm illustrates saved events. Explanation, journal, settings and replay use the same card deck.

changes.title: Real planning and simulated consequences
changes.description: Isolated teaching seasons use the local planner and execution ledger, dated B3 maintenance, explicit recovery selection, per-order delivery validation and three closing cards. Nothing advances while away.

changes.title: One current public game with protected history
changes.description: The root is an introduction and /play is the current game. Old public editions are retired with recoverable private state retained. Durable API admission, provider budgets and explicit-only adviser requests remain enforced.
